description: Strict binary Brier loss: one declared probability against one resolved binary outcome, after every eligibility check below; the question members in question_completeness must be known and an unknown unit is never compared.

eligibility.check: the forecast and the outcome pin the identical question reference (record type, id, revision, digest)
the pinned question record is available
the pinned question's members listed in question_completeness are values, not markers
output.probability is a declared value, not a marker
conditions is a value, not a marker
issued_at, information_cutoff and question.forecast_deadline are values, not markers
issued_at is not later than question.forecast_deadline, compared exactly; a day-precision issued_at is any instant of its date at UTC offsets -12:00 to +14:00
the order of issued_at and question.forecast_deadline is determinate (U5)
no limitation code on the forecast or the pinned question is listed in limitation_exclusions
observed.unit equals question.unit when both are values; an unknown unit is not comparable

limitations_note: Limitation codes not listed in limitation_exclusions are reported on the records but do not exclude.

narrative_candidates.note: Narrative records are never converted into forecasts; no confidence member is read as a probability.
source_assertion: no_declared_probability when stated_probability is not a value

pairing.rule: Each forecast (latest revision) pairs with the latest revision of the outcome recorded for the same question id.
